phrase.zh: 穿过薄片，另一种秩序显现。
phrase.en: Through a thin sheet, another order appears.

visual.zh: 一道细线从左侧穿向薄片，窄框与上下固定夹围住带有褶皱的薄片；后方斜立的记录面显出同心纹。
visual.en: A fine trace crosses from the left toward a wrinkled foil. A narrow hoop and clips above and below hold it in place; a slanted recording plane behind carries concentric marks.

background.zh:
汤姆孙与戴维森因实验发现电子被晶体衍射，共享1937年诺贝尔物理学奖，各获一半。汤姆孙研究高能电子穿过很薄的金属箔所产生的衍射效应。画面以窄金属框里的薄片、穿透细线和后方同心纹表达这条研究路径。薄片和记录面是原创寓意，不是实际装置复原；线纹不是测量数据或按比例绘制的电子轨迹。短句为原创。
1937年物理学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：实验发现电子被晶体衍射
background.en:
Thomson and Davisson shared the 1937 Nobel Prize in Physics equally for experimentally discovering electron diffraction by crystals. Thomson investigated diffraction as higher-energy electrons passed through very thin metal foil. A metal sheet in a slim hoop, penetrating traces and concentric marks behind it express this research route. The sheet and recording plane are original metaphors, not a reconstruction; the marks are neither measured data nor scaled electron trajectories. The phrase is original.
1937 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: for their experimental discovery of the diffraction of electrons by crystals
